sourceRefs.locator: In The Norse Sorceress, chapter 14, pp. 171–173 on the deposit in the access passage, beds and remains of the two women; pp. 177–178 and fig. 14.4 on the broken oak spade and the likely 953–975 window.

Antiquity 86, pp. 808–824, abstract and discussion of the dated tools and possible political motives for the reopenings in the tenth century. The authors propose a political setting, not an identification of the people.
The large stone, its decoration, the translated inscription, the dating around 965 and the discussion of earlier Christian objects and Harald Klak’s baptism at Mainz in 826.

labels.de: Spaten und Tragen im späteren Zugang
labels.en: Spades and stretchers in the later passage

note.de: Werkzeuge datieren den Eingriff am wahrscheinlichsten zwischen 953 und 975. Menschliche Knochen und Teile der Grabausstattung lagen im nachträglich angelegten Gang. Der Anlass bleibt umstritten.
note.en: Tools place the reopening most probably between 953 and 975. Human bones and parts of the grave furnishings lay in the later access passage. The motive is debated.
